people.name: Abdon
people.line: A minor judge of Israel from Ephraim

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Pirathon
people.line: A town in Ephraim, home of several notable Israelites

translations.web: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
translations.bsb: Then Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, died, and he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
translations.kjv: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
translations.asv: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill-country of the Amalekites.
